RecordThing.Description: When constructed, this kit places a {THING:StructureFastVent} on any support structure.

A {THING:StructurePassiveVent} with a spring-loaded flap. Gas from the room flows into the pipe as through any passive vent, but gas only leaves the pipe when the pipe is above {COLORORANGE:5 MPa}, and then only the gas above 5 MPa: the pipe is held at 5 MPa and the flap closes again. If the room itself is above 5 MPa, the two even out like a passive vent.
Its body is a tank: it adds as much volume to its pipe network as an in-line {THING:StructureTankSmallInLine}.
When constructed, this kit places a {THING:StructurePressureReliefVent} on any support structure.
